authors: J. Fokken, C. Sieg, M. Wilhelm
title: A piece of cake: the ground-state energies in gamma_i-deformed N=4 SYM theory at leading wrapping order
claim: Leading-wrapping-order anomalous dimensions of tr(Z^L) in the gamma_i-deformed theory from Feynman diagrams: for L >= 3 proportional to the maximally transcendental 'cake' integral and equal to the integrability (Luscher/TBA/Y-system) prediction; for L = 2 integrability diverges while the diagrammatic result is finite, rational and scheme dependent because an induced quartic double-trace coupling has non-zero beta function - conformal invariance broken even in the 't Hooft limit.
loop_order: leading wrapping order L for length L (exact loop numbers per L not verified)
scheme: Feynman diagrams, dimensional regularization, minimal-subtraction-type scheme (scheme dependence of L=2 result stated in abstract)
symmetry_argument: explicit; shows that the conformality assumption underlying the integrability prediction fails for L = 2

proved: L >= 3: field theory agrees with integrability at leading wrapping order (per abstract)
L = 2: result scheme dependent due to running double-trace coupling (per abstract)

red_flags: a clean example where a DR computation exposes the failure of (super)conformal protection assumed by integrability
scheme dependence of an 'anomalous dimension' signals that the quantity is not a CFT datum
cross_checks: integrability prediction (Luscher/TBA/Y-system) for L >= 3 agrees; for L = 2 diverges
